notes.title: A Brand New Level Pack: "Aberrations"
notes.content:
We love players of Neon Rider and want to make sure you have an amazing experience with the game. We've heard that you appreciated the last level pack because it expanded the game and added exciting new features and challenges. 

Now we've gone farther. Today we've released a brand-new level pack, "Aberrations," and we think it's going to blow your mind. Here's what's in the update.

 12 intense new levels
 wild new mechanics: gravity can now shift in any direction, allowing for topsy-turvy challenges that really extend your skills
 expands the overall play time and depth of play through intricate, flowing levels
 new color set options to improve colorblind accessibility
 a new achievement for completing "Aberrations" in under 17 minutes

It's a whole new year, and now you have a whole new level pack to make it a little more fun. We hope you enjoy Neon Rider. If you do, please leave a review for us—it really helps!

Keep Flipping,
— The AG Crew
